The application flow and decisioning may be instantaneous or take some time depending on internal checks.

• Premium metal card, luxury memberships (Club Marriott, EazyDiner) included

• Rewards / points for your everyday spending
• Perks like fuel surcharge waiver, insurance, lounge access (for premium)

How do rewards work in Selfe Card?
You can earn 5X reward points on the categories selected by you, while all other eligible transactions will earn base reward points.
When will Selfe Card memberships be available?
Your selected memberships will be available for claim after your card is activated and will reflect on the portal within T+3 working days.
How do I claim my membership?
You can claim your membership by logging into the Xchange portal, selecting your eligible membership, and completing the claim process in a few simple steps.
Is there a deadline to claim memberships?
Yes, all memberships must be claimed within 90 days from the card issuance date, failing which they will expire.
What happens if I fail to claim in time?
If the membership is not claimed within the specified timeline, it will expire automatically and cannot be renewed or reinstated later.
Can I transfer or exchange my membership?
No, all memberships are non-transferable and cannot be exchanged for cash or any other benefit, and can only be used by the eligible cardholder.
What is the Selfe Credit Card?

The Selfe Credit Card is a customizable credit card that allows you to personalize your card experience by selecting your preferred benefits, accelerated reward categories, memberships, and even the card design.
What customization options are available with Selfe Card?
With the Selfe Credit Card, you can customize billing cycle, card design and material type, OTT memberships, reward categories, and card network, giving you flexibility and control.
What happens if I do not select any preferences while applying for the Selfe Credit Card?

If you do not choose any preferences during the application process, the system will automatically assign default options as per the bank’s predefined configuration to ensure your card is issued without delay.
What are the default options assigned to my Selfe Credit Card?

In case no selections are made, the default options will be assigned as follows: Billing Cycle – 12th, Card Design – Regular, Memberships – Amazon Prime and Jio Hotstar, 5X Reward Categories – Apparel and Dining, and Card Network – RuPay
Will I still receive full benefits if defaults are assigned?
Yes, even with default selections, customers will continue to enjoy all applicable benefits, rewards, and memberships linked to their Selfe Credit Card.
Can I change my billing cycle for my credit card?
Yes, you have the option to change your billing cycle for your credit card, allowing you to better align your billing and payment due dates with your financial planning needs.
How many times can I change my billing cycle?
You can request a billing cycle change only once per credit card, so it is important to carefully choose the most suitable option before confirming your request.
How can I request a billing cycle change?
You can request a billing cycle change through the Mobile Banking (MB) App or by contacting the Customer Care Centre (CCC), making the process simple and convenient.
What billing cycle dates are available for selection?
You can choose from the available billing cycle dates which include the 5th, 12th, 13th, 14th, 15th, 16th, 18th, 20th, and 25th of the month.
Can I select a billing cycle date outside the available options?
No, you can only select from the predefined billing cycle dates provided by the bank, and requests for any other dates will not be accepted.
When will the new billing cycle be applied?
The revised billing cycle will typically be implemented in the next billing period after your request is processed, depending on system timelines.
Can I change my billing cycle again later?
No, as per policy, only one billing cycle change is allowed per credit card, and further changes will not be permitted once it has been updated.
Will my payment due date change if I update my billing cycle?
Yes, your payment due date will change accordingly since it is directly linked to your selected billing cycle.
Is there any fee for changing the billing cycle?
Currently, there is no specific fee mentioned for changing the billing cycle, but customers are advised to check the latest terms and conditions or confirm during the request.
What factors should I consider before changing my billing cycle?
You should consider your salary credit date, repayment capacity, and existing financial commitments before selecting a new billing cycle, to ensure it aligns with your repayment convenience.
How are reward points calculated for my transactions?

Reward points, including accelerated rewards, are calculated based on the Merchant Category Code (MCC) assigned to the merchant where the transaction is made, which determines the applicable reward category.
What is a Merchant Category Code (MCC)?
An MCC is a four-digit code assigned to merchants based on their primary business activity, which helps the bank classify transactions and determine rewards eligibility.
Why is MCC important for earning rewards?
The MCC helps determine whether your transaction qualifies for accelerated rewards, as reward categories are mapped to specific MCC codes defined by the bank.
Which MCCs are included in the Dining category?
Transactions will be classified under Dining if the merchant falls under MCCs 5462, 5812, or 5814, as defined by the bank for reward eligibility.
Which MCCs are included in the Apparel category?
Transactions will be considered under Apparel if they fall under MCCs 5311, 5611, 5621, 5641, 5651, 5691, 5655, 5631, or 5699.
Which MCCs are included in the Grocery category?

How can I redeem Credit Card points for rewards? +
Equitas uses a rewards portal called Xchange (xchange.equitas.bank.in) for redeeming reward points.
You can redeem for products, vouchers, flight / hotel booking, etc. The card’s Terms & Conditions / MITC specifies the catalogue, valuation, and conditions for redemption.
The exact value per point / the minimum points required / where you can redeem depends on which card you have and which redemption option (product, voucher, travel) you select.
How do I apply for a Credit Card online? +
Visit the Equitas Bank Website’s Credit Cards section.
Choose the variant (TIGA, SELFE or PowerMiles) and click “Apply Now.” Or by giving missed call 1800 103 2977
You will be asked to provide KYC, identity, address, income proofs, etc., to complete an online / offline application form. (Standard card application flow implied)
The bank will verify your eligibility and documents and, if approved, dispatch the card. (You may also need to activate it with first transaction or PIN setup)
The application flow and decisioning may be instantaneous or take some time depending on internal checks.
What are the advantages of using Equitas Credit Cards? +
Here are the main benefits per card, plus general advantages:
• 3× rewards on UPI, contactless payments, and on Pay-by-3 merchant spends
• “Pay by 3” — eligible transactions with select merchants can be auto converted into a 3-month low cost
• Up to 50 days of interest-free credit period for regular purchases
• Fuel surcharge waiver: 1% waiver on fuel transactions (within certain transaction bands)
• Insurance / protection covers: air accident, credit shield, lost card liability etc. (for primary cardholder)

• Choice of 2 memberships (Amazon Prime, Jio/Hotstar, Zee5, Sony LIV, etc.) as part of your benefits. Choice of 2 reward categories out of five (Apparel, Dining, Grocery, Utility, Taxi) where you’ll earn 5× points
• Standard rewards on all other spends
• Up to 50 days interest-free credit on regular purchases
• Fuel surcharge waiver, insurance covers, and domestic lounge (1 per quarter) benefit for SELFE
• Premium metal card, luxury memberships (Club Marriott, EazyDiner) included
• Lounge access (domestic + international) depending on card rules
• 3× rewards on international spends, plus ability to convert points to airline / hotel miles
• Fuel surcharge waiver, detection and Xchange program redemption options.
• Flexibility of interest-free credit period (if you pay full within due date)
• Rewards / points for your everyday spending
• Perks like fuel surcharge waiver, insurance, lounge access (for premium)
• Ability to convert large purchases into EMIs (for TIGA)
• Multiple redemption options via Equitas’s rewards portal
Are there any charges for redemption of reward points? +
Yes, the Equitas “Most Important Terms & Conditions (MITC)” document lists several fees, and redemption governed by reward programme rules.
2.5% of the amount withdrawn (or ₹250, whichever is higher). Also, finance charges apply from day of withdrawal till full repayment.
• The bank may levy other charges (late payment, over limit, return of payment, etc.) as per the Schedule of Charges in the Card Agreement / MITC.

•  • Redemption handling / administrative charges (if any) would be specified in the rewards programme terms (the MITC / catalogue) — it is possible that some redemptions may carry a small fee or conversion cost. (I didn’t find a publicly explicit “redemption fee” in the MITC I reviewed, so you will need to check the latest catalogue or rewards terms)
• TIGA: The annual fee may be waived if you spend a certain threshold in the anniversary year (as per terms)
• SELFE: Similarly, waiver if you cross a spending threshold (e.g., ₹2,00,000) in the year.
• PowerMiles: Waiver available if you spend a defined amount (e.g. ₹4,80,000) in the anniversary year.

So yes — while redemption may not always incur a direct separate fee (depending on the option), there are various fees built into the cards’ terms, and you must see the “Schedule of Charges / rewards programme” for your card variant.
How to register complaints related to my credit card? +
Register a complaint through the following ways:-
Write to customerservice@equitas.bank.in from your registered mail id
You can also lodge a complaint at RBI’s Sachet Portal
What memberships do I get with the PowerMiles Credit Card?
As a PowerMiles Credit Card holder, you are eligible to receive Club Marriott and EazyDiner memberships, which offer dining and lifestyle benefits through partner brands.
Yes, both memberships are provided completely free of cost on an annual basis, subject to meeting the eligibility criteria and adhering to the applicable terms and conditions.
When will I become eligible for these memberships?
You will become eligible for the memberships once you activate your credit card within the specified timeline, as activation is required to unlock these benefits.
When will my membership be available to claim?
Your membership details will be made available for claim within 3 working days (T+3) after your card is successfully activated.
Where do I claim my membership?
You can conveniently claim your membership by visiting the Xchange portal at xchange.equitas.bank.in and logging in with your registered credentials.
What is the last date to claim the membership?
You must ensure that you claim your membership within 90 days from the date of your card issuance, as this is the defined validity period.
Why have these default options been assigned to my card?
These default options are assigned as per bank policy when no customer preferences are selected during the application journey, to ensure seamless card issuance and benefit allocation.
Was this information shared during the application process?
Yes, the details regarding default selections are clearly mentioned in the application form, and customers are expected to review and select their preferences before submission.
Can I change the default options after the card is issued?
Once the card has been issued with default options, changes may not be allowed as selections are captured during the application. Customers may contact support for further guidance as per policy.
Can I raise a complaint if I did not select preferences?

As per policy, default options are automatically assigned when no selections are made and this is informed during the application process, hence such cases are generally not treated as service issues.
What should I do to avoid default selections in the future?
To avoid default assignment, customers should carefully review all available options and make their preferred selections during the application process before submitting the form.
Can I change my billing cycle for my credit card?
Yes, you have the option to change your billing cycle for your credit card, allowing you to better align your billing and payment due dates with your financial planning needs.
How many times can I change my billing cycle?
You can request a billing cycle change only once per credit card, so it is important to carefully choose the most suitable option before confirming your request.
How can I request a billing cycle change?
You can request a billing cycle change through the Mobile Banking (MB) App or by contacting the Customer Care Centre (CCC), making the process simple and convenient.
What billing cycle dates are available for selection?
You can choose from the available billing cycle dates which include the 5th, 12th, 13th, 14th, 15th, 16th, 18th, 20th, and 25th of the month.
Can I select a billing cycle date outside the available options?
No, you can only select from the predefined billing cycle dates provided by the bank, and requests for any other dates will not be accepted.
When will the new billing cycle be applied?
The revised billing cycle will typically be implemented in the next billing period after your request is processed, depending on system timelines.
Can I change my billing cycle again later?
No, as per policy, only one billing cycle change is allowed per credit card, and further changes will not be permitted once it has been updated.
Will my payment due date change if I update my billing cycle?
Yes, your payment due date will change accordingly since it is directly linked to your selected billing cycle.

The Corporate Visa Signature Credit Card provides exclusive benefits, rewards, and privileges for businesses, making it the ideal financial tool for managing business expenses effectively.

The Corporate Visa Signature Credit Card provides accident insurance cover of up to ₹1 crore for air travel and ₹3 lakh for road and rail travel.
How can I track my Corporate Visa Signature Credit Card application status?
You can track your application status online through the HDFC Bank website or by contacting their customer service helpline.
What are the annual fees associated with the Corporate Visa Signature Credit Card?

The annual fees for the Corporate Visa Signature credit card vary and are typically based on the type of business and card usage. You can find detailed information about the fees on the HDFC Bank website.
Can I add supplementary/add-on cardholders to my Corporate Visa Signature Credit Card account?

Can the shopkeeper charge an extra 2% for card payments?

A. Credit card companies and banks charge higher fees to recover the cost of lending money to customers. But, they urge merchants not to pass credit card swipe charges to customers and instead bear it themselves. In some places, merchants can charge customers an extra fee for using credit or debit cards to cover the processing costs.
How to pay rent through credit card?

A. The easiest way to pay rent is using credit cards . In this nothing is debited from your bank account . Instead the money is paid via the available line of credit. Rent payment through credit card is easy and just a few clicks away when it is linked to your UPI enabled app. Now you know how to pay rent through credit card.
A credit card is a transactional card that enables the holder to make purchases of goods and services or withdraw advance cash on credit .

Banks and financial institutions issue it to bring the convenience of payment. Credit cards act as a microloan tool where the individual makes purchases under the condition of paying off the same within a specific time period. There are no interest payouts if the due amount is paid within a specific time (interest-free period). The issuer pre-sets a custom borrowing limit, determining the maximum amount of credit a user can spend from a credit card. Credit cards allow users to save big through discounts and deals, making them popular.
Should I apply for a balance transfer credit card?

You may proceed with the balance transfer option if you see possible savings out of it. Paying high-interest debt doesn’t make sense when you can qualify for a new card with a 0% APR. This way, you can consolidate your debt and pay them off without any hassle. Many balance transfer credit cards offer a 0% or low interest rate on balance transfers for an introductory period, which can allow you to save money on interest charges while you pay down your debt.
What is the coverage scope of CPP membership in India

The coverage under CPP credit card protection membership in India is generally limited to the protection against loss, theft or misuse of the member's credit cards, debit cards, and other cards. CCP credit card protection also protects unauthorized transactions and emergency card replacement services.

Who should use the ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Card?

Can I make an online purchase with the ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Card?
Yes, you can easily make online purchases across India and at select overseas stores using the ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Card.
What are the benefits that I can get with the ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Card?

With the ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Card, you get discounts and Rewards on your ManU experiences. You also get complimentary airport lounge access, monthly discounts at BookMyShow, INOX and many more benefits.
What is the age limit for the ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Card?
You must be between the age group of 21 to 65 years to be eligible to apply for the ICICI Bank Manchester United Signature Credit Card.
What are the key variants of ICICI Bank Credit Cards?

The key variants of ICICI Bank Credit Cards are Platinum, Coral, Rubyx, Sapphiro and Emeralde. How can I see my Credit Card number online?

How can I redeem my Credit Card points?

How can I apply for a Credit Card online?

What is the welcome gift for Manchester United Cardholders?
As a welcome gift, Manchester United Credit Cardholders receive a Manchester United-Branded Holdall and Football. This exclusive merchandise adds to the excitement for fans of the club.
What does the top monthly spender receive?
The top spender (across all Cardholders) every month receives a signed Manchester United jersey, branded football or t-shirt.
What benefits do the top 18 spenders receive?

The top 18 spenders across Cardholders are rewarded with an exclusive fully-paid Manchester United Experience. This includes a private stadium and museum tour in Manchester, England, an opportunity to watch part of a First Team squad training session and a visit to the Manchester United megastore.
What is included in the private stadium tour?
The private stadium tour includes a guided visit to the historic Manchester United stadium and museum, offering an immersive experience of the club's legacy and achievements.
What are the criteria for availing domestic lounge access?

How can I redeem Credit Card points for rewards? +
Equitas uses a rewards portal called Xchange (xchange.equitasbank.com) for redeeming reward points.
You can redeem for products, vouchers, flight / hotel booking, etc. The card’s Terms & Conditions / MITC specifies the catalogue, valuation, and conditions for redemption.
The exact value per point / the minimum points required / where you can redeem depends on which card you have and which redemption option (product, voucher, travel) you select.
How do I apply for a Credit Card online? +
Visit the Equitas Bank Website’s Credit Cards section.
Choose the variant (TIGA, SELFE or PowerMiles) and click “Apply Now.” Or by giving missed call 1800 103 2977
You will be asked to provide KYC, identity, address, income proofs, etc., to complete an online / offline application form. (Standard card application flow implied)
The bank will verify your eligibility and documents and, if approved, dispatch the card. (You may also need to activate it with first transaction or PIN setup)
The application flow and decisioning may be instantaneous or take some time depending on internal checks.
What are the advantages of using Equitas Credit Cards? +
Here are the main benefits per card, plus general advantages:
• 3× rewards on UPI, contactless payments, and on Pay-by-3 merchant spends
• “Pay by 3” — eligible transactions with select merchants can be auto converted into a 3-month low cost
• Up to 50 days of interest-free credit period for regular purchases
• Fuel surcharge waiver: 1% waiver on fuel transactions (within certain transaction bands)
• Insurance / protection covers: air accident, credit shield, lost card liability etc. (for primary cardholder)

• Choice of 2 memberships (Amazon Prime, Jio/Hotstar, Zee5, Sony LIV, etc.) as part of your benefits. Choice of 2 reward categories out of five (Apparel, Dining, Grocery, Utility, Taxi) where you’ll earn 5× points
• Standard rewards on all other spends
• Up to 50 days interest-free credit on regular purchases
• Fuel surcharge waiver, insurance covers, and domestic lounge (1 per quarter) benefit for SELFE
• Premium metal card, luxury memberships (Club Marriott, EazyDiner) included
• Lounge access (domestic + international) depending on card rules
• 3× rewards on international spends, plus ability to convert points to airline / hotel miles
• Fuel surcharge waiver, detection and Xchange program redemption options.
• Flexibility of interest-free credit period (if you pay full within due date)
• Rewards / points for your everyday spending
• Perks like fuel surcharge waiver, insurance, lounge access (for premium)
• Ability to convert large purchases into EMIs (for TIGA)
• Multiple redemption options via Equitas’s rewards portal
Are there any charges for redemption of reward points? +
Yes, the Equitas “Most Important Terms & Conditions (MITC)” document lists several fees, and redemption governed by reward programme rules.
2.5% of the amount withdrawn (or ₹250, whichever is higher). Also, finance charges apply from day of withdrawal till full repayment.
• The bank may levy other charges (late payment, over limit, return of payment, etc.) as per the Schedule of Charges in the Card Agreement / MITC.

•  • Redemption handling / administrative charges (if any) would be specified in the rewards programme terms (the MITC / catalogue) — it is possible that some redemptions may carry a small fee or conversion cost. (I didn’t find a publicly explicit “redemption fee” in the MITC I reviewed, so you will need to check the latest catalogue or rewards terms)
• TIGA: The annual fee may be waived if you spend a certain threshold in the anniversary year (as per terms)
• SELFE: Similarly, waiver if you cross a spending threshold (e.g., ₹2,00,000) in the year.
• PowerMiles: Waiver available if you spend a defined amount (e.g. ₹4,80,000) in the anniversary year.

So yes — while redemption may not always incur a direct separate fee (depending on the option), there are various fees built into the cards’ terms, and you must see the “Schedule of Charges / rewards programme” for your card variant.
What is the Pay by 3 program?
It is a feature for Tiga Card where eligible transactions at select merchants are automatically converted into a 3-month EMI, making payments easier without manual conversion.
Which transactions are eligible for Pay by 3?
Only transactions done at partner merchants are eligible. Non-partner and UPI transactions are excluded.
What interest is charged under Pay by 3?
It comes with no additional cost from the customer
When are transactions converted into EMI?
Transactions are converted into EMI only on the statement generation date.
How is EMI billed in the statement?
Only the EMI instalment is billed, while other transactions are billed in full.
Will my credit limit be blocked?
Yes, full transaction amount is blocked and released gradually as EMIs are repaid.
Yes, pre-closure is allowed with applicable charges and reversal of benefits.
What happens if a transaction is reversed?
Reversal is adjusted in next statement and affects EMI conversion based on net amount.
Yes, 3X accelerated reward points are credited in the next billing cycle.
What is the reward point value?
₹0.15 for travel/vouchers and ₹0.10 for cashback redemption.
Minimum 500 points required for cashback, validity 24 months, ₹99 redemption fee applicable.
Can I change my billing cycle for my credit card?
Yes, you have the option to change your billing cycle for your credit card, allowing you to better align your billing and payment due dates with your financial planning needs.
How many times can I change my billing cycle?
You can request a billing cycle change only once per credit card, so it is important to carefully choose the most suitable option before confirming your request.
How can I request a billing cycle change?
You can request a billing cycle change through the Mobile Banking (MB) App or by contacting the Customer Care Centre (CCC), making the process simple and convenient.
What billing cycle dates are available for selection?
You can choose from the available billing cycle dates which include the 5th, 12th, 13th, 14th, 15th, 16th, 18th, 20th, and 25th of the month.
Can I select a billing cycle date outside the available options?
No, you can only select from the predefined billing cycle dates provided by the bank, and requests for any other dates will not be accepted.
When will the new billing cycle be applied?
The revised billing cycle will typically be implemented in the next billing period after your request is processed, depending on system timelines.
Can I change my billing cycle again later?
No, as per policy, only one billing cycle change is allowed per credit card, and further changes will not be permitted once it has been updated.
Will my payment due date change if I update my billing cycle?
Yes, your payment due date will change accordingly since it is directly linked to your selected billing cycle.
Is there any fee for changing the billing cycle?
Currently, there is no specific fee mentioned for changing the billing cycle, but customers are advised to check the latest terms and conditions or confirm during the request.
What factors should I consider before changing my billing cycle?
You should consider your salary credit date, repayment capacity, and existing financial commitments before selecting a new billing cycle, to ensure it aligns with your repayment convenience.
How are reward points calculated for my transactions?

Reward points, including accelerated rewards, are calculated based on the Merchant Category Code (MCC) assigned to the merchant where the transaction is made, which determines the applicable reward category.
What is a Merchant Category Code (MCC)?
An MCC is a four-digit code assigned to merchants based on their primary business activity, which helps the bank classify transactions and determine rewards eligibility.
Why is MCC important for earning rewards?
The MCC helps determine whether your transaction qualifies for accelerated rewards, as reward categories are mapped to specific MCC codes defined by the bank.
Which MCCs are included in the Dining category?
Transactions will be classified under Dining if the merchant falls under MCCs 5462, 5812, or 5814, as defined by the bank for reward eligibility.

Who can I pay using Supplier payment?
You can pay any registered supplier with a valid GST number.
What if money is not credited into the beneficiary account after 1 to 2 days?
In rare cases, due to technical issues, Banks may take additional time to deposit the payment money into the receiver account.
Can a cardholder avail flexible payment options on the Pine Labs HDFC Bank Pro Credit Card?
Yes. The flexible payment options of No cost EMI and Low-cost EMI can be availed by a cardholder on the credit card.
How does a cardholder get credit card monthly statement?
Once the bill is generated, the credit card monthly statement is sent to the cardholder’s registered email address. A cardholder can also view and d
Download the bill by logging into HDFC Bank website.
How does a cardholder activate the Pine Labs HDFC Bank Pro Credit Card for online, contactless and/or international transactions?

The Pine Labs HDFC Bank Credit Card will be disabled for online, contactless and/or international transactions initially to protect against fraud. A cardholder can enable the card through HDFC website.
For further details on card activation, please visit HDFC Bank website or refer to the leaflets in the welcome kit.

For Pine Labs HDFC Bank Pro Credit Card, Renewal fee can be waived off upon spending Rs.1,00,000 (Non-EMI Spends) in a 12 months’ period.
How can I add a beneficiary?
You can add a beneficiary from the “Pay Supplier” or “Manage Beneficiaries” sections once you log in to the link ( https://credit.pinelabs.com/ccc/login ):
If you have clicked the “Manage Beneficiary page”, tap on “Add New Beneficiary”.
Enter the Beneficiary Mobile No, Bank Account No. & IFSC Code.
Enter the GST details and click on “Continue” to proceed.
Is GST mandatory for supplier payment?
Yes, GST of the beneficiary is mandatory. We require the GST of the beneficiary to validate all Supplier payments
Why was my money deducted for a failed transaction?

If your money is deducted for a failed payment, there is no need to worry as your money is safe with your bank. The amount is refunded into your account within 8-10 business days from date you made the payment.
What is fuel surcharge waiver fees?
1% Fuel Surcharge waiver on fuel transactions (Minimum transaction of ₹400, Maximum transaction of ₹5,000 & Maximum Cashback of ₹250 per statement cycle)
What documents does a cardholder need to submit to the agent for the Pine Labs HDFC Bank Pro Credit Card?
The Credit card application process is completely digital. However, if KYC cannot be done online, HDFC Bank representatives will contact the Cardholder to complete KYC.

To make a cardholder travel more comfortably, Pine Labs HDFC Bank Pro Credit Card offers complimentary access to airport lounges within India. A cardholder can relax in the comforts of the lounge while they wait for the flight. Pine Labs HDFC Bank Pro Credit cardholders can avail up to 8 lounge (capped at 2 visits per quarter) access within India in a calendar year.
What should a cardholder do in case of credit card being lost/stolen?
In case of credit card being lost/stolen, a cardholder should login to HDFC Bank online at once and report the lost or stolen credit card in the service requests section in the menu.
What's the maximum payment amount possible using Supplier payment?
The maximum amount that can be transferred using Supplier payment is the available Credit Limit on your credit card at the time of making the payment.

Reward Points shall not be eligible for the following spends/transactions on the credit card -
Payment of card fees and other charges
Smart EMI / Dial in EMI transactions

Pine Labs HDFC Bank  Credit Card is exclusively offered for Pine Labs merchants. Pine Labs in partnership with HDFC Bank is offering the card.

Usually, a transaction remains in initiated state for 1-3 business days before it is changes to either successful or failed. In case of failed status, money deducted will be refunded to the sender's account.

Ready to take the next step?

IndiGo BluChip is IndiGo’s new loyalty program. Customers will have a BluChip account registered with their mobile number and email ID, and all benefits of the IndiGo Kotak card (BluChips and vouchers) will be credited to this account.
What happens to my 6E Rewards balance?

If you were a 6E Rewards cardholder, by 3rd October ’25, all your 6E Rewards balance was converted to IndiGo BluChips with an 18% bonus and credited to your BluChip account. This bonus is exclusive to Kotak 6E Rewards cardholders to give them a kick-start with the new card.
What are the features of the new IndiGo Kotak CC?

The new IndiGo Kotak Cards are feature-rich. To take a glimpse, check our Value Chart and see what the card has to offer. Welcome benefit, IndiGo BluChips on every transaction, milestone benefit, renewal benefit, and domestic lounge access are available to cardholders.
Is there any capping on the IndiGo BluChips I can earn in a year?
No. You can earn IndiGo BluChips for every transaction you make without any capping.
Is there any criteria to be eligible for lounge access?
No. There is no eligibility criterion for lounge access on the card. Customers can avail 2 domestic lounge visits per calendar quarter .
I have recently paid the fee on my 6E Rewards card and I got a fee levied on my new IndiGo card as well. Please clarify.

If you have upgraded from the 6E Rewards card to the IndiGo Kotak Premium card, you will be subject to a new anniversary cycle, effectively reinitiating your card anniversary date. This means a joining fee will be levied for the month of October ’25, and upon payment, you will receive the welcome benefits.
If a customer was levied an annual fee on their 6E Rewards card from April ’25 onwards and has paid the fee within the due date, then they are eligible to receive:
700 IndiGo BluChips if they had a 6E Rewards card, post activating the new IndiGo card (within 30 days).
1500 IndiGo BluChips if they had a 6E Rewards XL card, post activating the new IndiGo card (within 30 days).
This is a compensatory upgrade bonus and will be credited to the customer’s BluChip account.
